title: K-injective targets turn quasi-isomorphisms into Hom bijections
statement: In an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $K$ be an object of the homotopy category and let $I$ be a K-injective cochain complex [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. The canonical localization map $Qh.map:\operatorname{Hom}_{K}(K,QI)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D}(QK,QI)$ is bijective.
